# Security policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

Never post credentials, PAT, Kaggle tokens, private URLs or privileged logs to GitHub issues. Report vulnerabilities confidentially to **i.am@dangkhoa.dev**. TPU HTTP remains unqualified and loopback-only; do not expose it via tunnels before security review. Rotate compromised credentials immediately.
